about:
Orion Manufacturing LLC was established in 2009 in Mystic, Connecticut, by Byron N. Foote and Geoffrey Foote, with Byron C. Foote joining the ownership group later. The company began as a modern architectural woodworking facility focused on custom millwork and furnishings for interior spaces.

The shop fabricates and installs architectural millwork throughout New England, blending innovation with high-quality materials to produce finished interiors. Its capabilities span custom millwork production, custom furnishings, and on-site installation, though specific equipment, facility size, and headcount are not disclosed.

Orion serves architects, designers, and contractors across commercial and residential projects in the New England region. The company's portfolio includes custom millwork and furnishings for interior spaces, though specific client names or industry verticals are not publicly listed.

The founders started the business to combine craftsmanship with innovative approaches to millwork, aiming to meet demanding specifications and quality standards. The company emphasizes ingenuity and material quality as key differentiators in its market.
